name: The Rim Trade
description: An isolationist rim empire holds the galaxy's rarest luxuries and trades them only for goods from the outer reaches.

flags.name: rimTrader
flags.label: Rim trader behaviour
flags.description: The Oranthi Concord trades its rare goods only for rim goods, never declares war and barely expands.

flags.name: rimTraderPassive
flags.label: Passive Concord (anger)
flags.description: The Concord's warships stay inside its own colonised systems (defence only: no raids, bombardment or invasions; the treasure fleet's escorts still sail with it) and it declares war only on an empire that provoked it: declared war on it, attacked or destroyed its ships or bases, attacked, blockaded or invaded its colonies, sank a treasure ship, sabotaged or assassinated through a caught agent, or let its rim-trade standing fall below the anger threshold. An angered Concord may declare war and strike that empire's assets near its space; its anger cools each year of peace. Without any war it also exacts a price: strike fleets (warships the home guard can spare) hunt the offender's ships and bases anywhere in the galaxy — never its colonies — until it has destroyed twice the value it lost. Off: it never declares war and its fleets roam as any AI's.

flags.name: rimTraderSinglePort
flags.label: Single trading port
flags.description: Foreign freighters may buy from the Concord only at its capital port.

flags.name: treasureBeacon
flags.label: Treasure fleet beacon
flags.description: The Concord's treasure fleet is visible to every empire, wherever it sails.

flags.name: concordArt
flags.label: Concord art
flags.description: The Concord's own ships: real insect specimen photos (public domain) recoloured and fitted with rusted cybernetic grafts, blinking blue lights and moving limbs at close zoom; egg-sac bases; the insect-mask portrait and flag (off: the Ackdarian art its race borrows). Display only.
